message:
fix(apk): a loss the decoder sees trims what it broke out of the queue, an IDR that commits closes the gap behind it, no automatic re-ordering (keepalive-r2 e, apk-decoder-inbox C r2, Codex codex_apk_inbox_c_src_r1.md N1 N3)

N1-a (Codex: delta12, delta13, IDR14 queued, MarkLoss(11) -> the first Pop was delta12): MarkLoss now DROPS the queued
deltas up to the first IDR after the loss (counted: chainTrim) -- the chain restarts there and its suffix is kept, no
gap; with no IDR queued everything goes and the tail gap opens after the newest lost. The worker also drops a delta
past an open gap's loss point (defensive, beyondGap, expected 0).
N1-b (Codex's product-sink sequence: IDR1 in, delta2 pending, IDR3 replaces it, IDR3 commits, delta4 -> GapDelta,
tailGap 1, a new episode): a loss with a usable IDR after it held OUTSIDE the inbox (the pending slot, going in now)
opens no gap -- the queue is that IDR's suffix; a loss at a seq before the IDR this codec already took is recovered
(lossRecovered, no episode, no gap); an IDR that commits closes a gap opened for a loss before it (a loss after it
keeps its gap). The committed-IDR marker is forgotten with the codec, the inbox and the asks.
N3: the 30-in-a-row resync is removed -- duplicate / older AUs stay dropped however many come; the order starts over
only at an explicit reset (a new pick / binding / stream).

Tests: decoder_chain_inbox_test 51/51 (+ N3: 40 older + 40 duplicate dropped, increase goes on, reset -> new IDR; +
N1-a: Codex's counterexample -> first Pop IDR14, no-IDR -> all dropped and the gap; + N1-b: an outside IDR keeps the
suffix; commit closes, a later loss keeps). android_decoder_inbox_c_test 35/35 (+ [C9] Codex's N1-b sequence: fed
IDR3 then delta4, tailGap 0, no new episode; a loss after IDR3 keeps its gap; a reset before the commit keeps the
later gap; + [C10] the slot's loss at d2 trims d3 out, the next input is IDR4). Regressions: inbox 12/12, owed_key
32/32, geometry 10/10, binding 17/17, decode_stats 42/42, liveness 68/68, session_liveness 9/9, pending_slot 21/21,
prelogin_select 60/60. N2 and §8 follow. No device run.
